paite: Huan tang a kipan a ahong paisuk nung in mipi tampitak in amah azuita uhi.
heading: Phak Hihdamna / (Mar 1.40-45; Luk 5.12-16)
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

paite: Ngai in, akiang ah phak khat ahong pai a, "Toupa, na utleh na hon hihsiangthou thei hi,” chi in abia hi.
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

paite: Jesu'n sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangthouta in," achi hi. Thakhat in phak hong siangthou pah hi.
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuamah hilh lou ding in pilvang in, himahleh siampu kiang ah va kilak inla, Mosi in thilpiak ding achihte lan in; amau hon theihchetna ding un," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

paite: Kapernaum a lut in, akiang ah sepaih zaheutu ahong pai hi.
heading: Sepaih Zaheutu Sikha Hihdamna / (Luk 7.1-10)
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

paite: "Toupa, inn ah ka sikha alum maimah a, nakpitak a hihnat in a-om," chi in ana ngen hi.
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Ka hong pai dia, ka hihdam ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

paite: Sepaih zaheutu'n, "Toupa, ka insung na lutna tak ahi kei, thu kia gen lechin ka sikha adam mai ding.
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

paite: Kei leng mi thunuai a om ka hi a, ka nuai ah sepaihte a-om ua, 'nang pai in,' ka chihleh apai zel a; midang kiang ah, 'nang hong pai in,' ka chihleh ahong pai zel; ka sikha kiang ah leng, 'hiai hih in' ka chihleh ahih zel," chi in adawng hi.
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n hiai thu azak in lamdang asa a, amah zuite kiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, Israelte lak ah hichi tel a ginna thupi ka mu kei hi.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, suahlam leh tumlam a pan mi tampi ahong pai ding ua, van-gam ah Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang ah atu ding uh.
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

paite: Gam tate zaw polam mial ah paihkhiak in a-om ding uh; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding," achi hi.
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, "Paita in, na gin bang in na tung ah tung hen," achi a, huchi in sikha adamta hi.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

paite: Peter inn ah Jesu alut a, azi nu khosik a lum amu hi.
heading: Peter Sungnu Leh Mi Tampi Hihdamna / (Mar 1.29-34; Luk 4.38-41)
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

paite: Akhut akhoihsak a, akhosik adaita; athou a, a-nna asepsakta hi.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in akiang ah dawimatte tampi ahon pi ua; thu in dawite adelhkhia a, damlou tengteng ahihdam hi.
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

paite: Zawlnei Isai in, "Amah ngei in i hatlouhnate ala a, i natnate apua," chi a agen hong tangtun theihna ding in.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

paite: Jesu'n akimvel a mipi tampitak amuh in, gal khat lam a pai ding in thu apia hi.
heading: Nungzui Dingte Theihna / (Luk 9.57-62)
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

paite: Laigelhmi khat ahong pai a, akiang ah, "Heutupa, na paina peuh ah ka hon zui ding," achi hi.
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sehalte'n kua anei ua, tungleng vasate'n leng bu anei uh, himahleh Mihing Tapa in zaw lungakna ding mun anei kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

paite: Huan anungzuite lak a midang khat in, "Toupa, ka pa hon vuisak phot in," achi hi.
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang ah, "Hon zui in; misi in amau misi kivui uhen," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

paite: Huan long sung ah alut a, anungzuite'n azui uhi.
heading: Jesu'n Huihpi Daisak / (Mar 4.35-41; Luk 8.22-25)
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

paite: Ngai in, tuipi ah huihpi hattak ahong nung a, huchi in tuikihot in long atumtou a; himahleh amah a-ihmu hi.
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

paite: Huan akiang a hong pai in aphawng ua, "Toupa, hon hondam in, mangthang ding ka kei uhiam,” achi uhi.
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou ginglahte aw, bangziak a lau na hi ua?" achi hi. Huchi in athou a, huih leh tuipi atai a; huan ahong dai sipsipta hi.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

paite: Huan mite'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi. "Hiai mi bangchidan ahia, huih leh tuipi nangawn in athu aman uh?" achi uhi.
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

paite: Huan gal khat lam Gadaren mite gam atun in dawimat nih, han a kipan hong pawt in, ahon tuak ua; ahang mahmah ua, huchi in huai lampi ah kuamah apai thei kei uhi.
heading: Dawimat Mi Nih Jesu Hihdamna / (Mar 5.1-20; Luk 8.26-39)
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

paite: Ngai in, amau, "Pathian Tapa kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hunchiam tun ma a koute hon gawt ding a hong pai na hi maw?" chi in akikou uhi.
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

paite: Huan a-omna ua kipan gamla khop ah vokhon tampi agamta uhi.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

paite: Huan dawite'n, "N'on delhkhiak aleh huai a vokhonte sung ah hon lutsak in," chi in akiang ah nakpi in angen uhi.
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Pai un," achi a, huchi in ahong pawtkhia ua, vok sung ah alut ua; ngai in, vokhon tengteng tui gei ken lak ah ataisuk ua, tuipi a tailut in, tui ah amangthangta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

paite: Huan ganvulte atai ua, khua ah apai ua, dawimatte tung a thil hong tungte bangkim ahilhta uhi.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

paite: Ngai in, akhua in Jesu mu ding in ahong pawt ua; amah amuhtak un agam ua kipan a pawtkhe ding in nakpi in angen uhi.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
